SELECT c.oid::text AS relation_id,n.nspname AS schema, current_schema() AS configured_schema,current_user AS principal, session_user AS login,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS table_owner, c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.oid=to_regclass('operational_effect_journal') AND c.relkind='r'

WHERE a.datname=current_database() AND a.usename NOT IN(current_user,$2) AND a.pid<>pg_backend_pid()) AS other_client_sessions FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname=current_user JOIN pg_database d ON d.datname=current_database() WHERE c.oid=$1::oid
